title: Henry VIII - OverSimplified
beats: Dying Henry asks was I a good king; answer: remembered for wife killings
Mummy teaching toddler Henry words; he mangles them into divorce/off with her head/supreme head: preview of the whole reign as jokes
1491 setup: civil war ends, Henry VII, heir Arthur, Henry only the spare
Arthur is a bargaining tool; Spain alliance motivates everything after
Young Henry the cool, theology-loving scholar prince, not the tyrant
Tutor's textbook rules (do not be mean, do not violate widows) planted
Arthur dies; Henry inherits heir role and brother's widow; Pope dispensation (the loophole later reversed)
Henry VIII crowned beloved, generous, married for love; contrast with later tyrant
Honey ad woven into war-funding plot
Wolsey tells Henry he is the king and can do as he likes; planted line
French war, glory, no male heir, daughter Mary born
Cloth of Gold, Charles V betrayal; alliance collapses, wife loses her utility
Anne Boleyn, divorce request, Wolsey defers to Pope controlled by Charles
Gout running gag stalls trial two years; Pope says no
Henry repeats Wolsey's king line back; breaks from Rome, supreme head
Tudor court excess; monasteries dissolved to pay
Tutor lines inverted as joust shouts; 1536 fall as turning point
Anne executed, Seymour, Cleves, Howard, Parr: wife sequence as rhythm
Final Boulogne victory; narrator admits it nearly bankrupted England
Why are we fascinated: legacy of authority; and also the wife killings

new_moves.name: planted-line-payoff

new_moves.name: frame-story-question
new_moves.what: Whole video told as dying man's reflection answering one question

theory: The video teaches causality of a long biography by planting short memorable lines early and paying them off later, so the sequence feels inevitable. Comic skits make each causal hinge a scene rather than a date.
velocity: Orchestrator: plant a tagged phrase in early scene and schedule an inverted callback later as a recall probe
Scene builder: turn each causal hinge into a short two-voice dialogue
Evals: check each beat's cause was introduced earlier
